genre: narrative dialogue — gender-distinct speakers (Harriet, Mr. Calloway)
note: The easy case: one male, one female, alternating. A correct binder should get all of these; they anchor the battery so a tuning that helps the hard case can't quietly wreck the easy one.

bindings.sentence: There are debts no one spoke of
How much is left, when the debts are paid
The house, and a little besides
Most women in your position would sell
Then we shall have to find another way
